title: 请求、提议与邀请的应答
goal: 识别请求、提议、邀请与建议，并区分接受、委婉拒绝和有条件接受。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

points.label: 识别委婉拒绝或有条件接受的回应

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 请求是让对方做事，提议是提出共同的安排。邀请是问对方是否参加，建议是给对方一个办法。正确的回应要表明做还是不做。只介绍物品、地点或活动的话，不算回应。

body.box:
Could you fasten this strap? → Certainly, hold it still.
Why don't we use the side entrance? → Good idea; it's less crowded.

body.p: 开头客气，不一定就是接受。I’d love to, but I’m away that day 先表示愿意，再说明不能参加。结果看 but 后面的话。

steps.d: 先听清由谁做什么。Could you fasten this strap? 是请对方系带子。Can I help with that strap? 是说话人主动帮忙。
分清接受、拒绝和有条件接受。That works for me 是接受。I wish I could 是做不到的愿望，表示不能参加。
听到 but、if、as long as，要听清后面的条件。I can help after lunch 是答应午饭后帮忙，现在不行。

cards.title: 请求与提议
rows: 请求
Could you / Would you + 动作，请对方做事。
Could you label these jars? → Certainly.
礼貌请求
Would you mind + doing，问是否介意做事。
Would you mind holding this rope? → Not at all; I've got it.
请求许可
Would you mind if I + 过去式，说话人请求让自己做某事。
Would you mind if I moved this stool? → Go ahead.
共同提议
Shall we / Why don’t we / How about 提出共同安排。
How about trying the smaller tent? → Let's do that.
邀请
Would you like to / Do you want to + 活动，询问参加意愿。
Would you like to join the tasting? → I'd be delighted.
建议
Why don’t you / You could / It might help to 提供办法。
You could ask for a replacement. → I'll try that.
主动提供帮助
Shall I / Would you like me to，说话人主动提出帮忙。
Shall I carry the toolbox? → That would be helpful.

cards.title: 接受与拒绝
rows: 直接接受
表示愿意去做，不只是说自己能做。
Certainly. I'll do it now.
接受安排
That works / Sounds good 表示方案可行。
That works for me. Let's meet there.
不介意
回答 mind 时，Not at all 表示不介意，即同意。
Not at all. Please use it.
委婉拒绝
I’d love to, but 后接不能参加的原因。
I'd love to, but I'm away all weekend.
愿望式拒绝
I wish I could 表示想做但做不到。
I wish I could, but I'm on duty then.
有条件接受
if / as long as 后面是答应的条件。
I can, as long as we're finished by noon.
改换时间
原定时间不行，提出另一个时间。
Not this afternoon, but I'm free tomorrow.

body.box: Could you help me hang the stage curtains before lunch?

Choose the best response.
1. The curtains arrived before lunch yesterday.
2. I can, as long as we finish by eleven.
3. The stage is behind the dining room.
4. I had lunch with the stage crew.

body.p: Could you help 是请对方帮忙挂幕布，before lunch 是时间。第二项的 I can 接受了请求，as long as 加了一个条件：十一点前完成。
第二项是有条件接受。第一项说幕布何时到货，第三项说舞台在哪里，第四项说过去和谁吃过饭。这三项都没有回答帮不帮忙。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 礼貌开头误判
I'd love to, but I'm away. 被当作同意。
能否参加看 but 后面的话。
否定词误判
Not at all. Go ahead. 被当作拒绝。
mind 问的是是否介意，不介意就是同意。
行动主体错误
Shall I carry it? → I already asked him.
Shall I 是说话人自己要帮忙，先分清由谁做。
只答相关细节
Could you label it? → The label is blue.
只介绍物品，没有回答做不做。
条件遗漏
I can after six. 被当作随时都能。
after six 是条件，六点以后才行。

lines.text: Could you hold the gate while I lead the horse through?

options: Sure, I'll lead the horse.
The gate opens toward the yard.
Certainly, I'll keep it open.
No thanks, I can manage.
items.why: Could you hold the gate 是请对方扶住门，I'll keep it open 接受了这项请求，即第三项。

lines.text: Shall we place the sculpture near the entrance?

options: No thanks, I can move it alone.
Yes, that spot would work well.
The sculpture is made of metal.
Yes, it was moved there last week.
items.why: Shall we place 提议把雕塑放在入口附近，that spot would work well 表示赞成，即第二项。

lines.text: Would you like me to carry the basket of apples?

options: The apples came from our orchard.
Sure, I'll carry it to the car for you.
I'd like to, but it's too heavy.
That would help; it's quite heavy.
items.why: Would you like me to carry 是说话人主动帮忙，That would help 接受了帮助，即第四项。

lines.text: Why don’t you soak the paintbrush before cleaning it?

options: Good idea; I'll leave it in water.
Sure, I'll clean it for you now.
The brush has a wooden handle.
Yes, I soaked it after cleaning it.
items.why: Why don’t you soak 是建议对方先把画笔泡一泡，leave it in water 表示采用这个办法，即第一项。

lines.text: Would you join our bird count at dawn on Sunday?

options: Birds are easiest to hear at dawn.
I'm on an overnight shift until Sunday noon.
Yes, I counted the birds there last Sunday morning.
No, the count starts right at dawn.
items.why: 值班到 Sunday noon，与 at dawn on Sunday 的活动时间冲突。第二项用这个理由委婉拒绝。

lines.text: Can you help unload the flower delivery at nine?

options: The flowers are for a wedding.
Yes, I unloaded it at nine.
I can if the driver can wait until ten.
Thanks, but I can unload it all by myself.
items.why: if the driver can wait until ten 说明十点才能帮忙。第三项是有条件接受，不是答应九点到场。

lines.text: How about taking the coastal route for our drive?

options: The coast is popular in summer.
No thanks, I can drive myself.
Yes, we took that route last autumn.
I'd rather stay inland this time.
items.why: I’d rather stay inland 提出走另一条路，表示不接受沿海路线的提议，即第四项。

lines.text: Could you watch my stall while I get more change?

options: Only if you're back before my break.
The stall sells handmade soap.
Sure, I'll go and get the change for you.
Thanks, but I have enough change.
items.why: Only if you're back before my break 给照看摊位加了条件：对方要在休息前回来。第一项是有条件接受。

lines.text: Would you mind turning the compost while I fetch a fork?

options: The fork is beside the compost bin.
Not at all; I'll start at this end.
Yes, I'll fetch the fork for you.
Thanks, but I can turn it myself.
items.why: Would you mind 是请对方翻堆肥。Not at all 表示不介意，I’ll start 表示马上动手，即第二项。

lines.text: Shall we use the quieter room for the oral history recording?

options: No thanks, I can make the recording on my own.
Yes, the room was quiet yesterday.
The recorder has two microphones.
Yes, that should reduce the background noise.
items.why: Shall we use 提出共同的安排。第四项的 Yes 表示赞成，reduce the background noise 是赞成的理由。

lines.text: Would you like to join us for the lantern walk?

options: I'd be happy to; where are we meeting?
The lanterns are stored upstairs.
Yes, I joined the walk with my family last year.
Sure, I'll lend you a lantern.
items.why: I’d be happy to 直接接受了邀请，随后问在哪里集合，即第一项。

lines.text: You could test the dye on a small piece of cloth first.

options: Sure, I'll test it for you first.
The dye comes in small bottles.
That makes sense; I'll try a scrap.
Yes, I dyed the first piece yesterday.
items.why: You could 是建议先在小块布上试染，I'll try a scrap 表示采纳这个建议，即第三项。

lines.text: Could you lend me your easel for the whole weekend?

options: Yes, if it's back by Saturday evening.
The easel is made of light wood.
Thanks, but I already have an easel.
Sure, I'll borrow yours for the weekend.
items.why: if it’s back by Saturday evening 限定了归还时间：只能借到周六晚上，不是整个周末。第一项是有条件接受。

lines.text: Would you like to come to the beekeeping demonstration on Friday?

options: The demonstration takes place outdoors.
Yes, I went to the one they held last Friday.
Sure, I'll show you how to keep the bees on Friday.
I'd like to, but I'll be out of town that day.
items.why: I’d like to 先表示愿意，but 后面说那天不在本地。第四项是委婉的拒绝。

lines.text: Could you cover my shift at the animal shelter tomorrow morning?

options: The shelter opens in the morning.
I wish I could, but I'm working elsewhere then.
Thanks, but I can cover the morning shift myself.
Yes, I covered it this morning.
items.why: I wish I could 是做不到的愿望，but I'm working elsewhere then 说明那时要在别处上班。第二项是委婉的拒绝。

lines.text: How about rehearsing the puppet show at my house tonight?

options: The puppets are made of fabric.
Yes, my house has a large front room.
Tonight won't work; could we do tomorrow?
Yes, the last show went well.
items.why: Tonight won’t work 拒绝的是今晚这个时间，could we do tomorrow 提出改到明天。第三项拒绝的只是时间，排练仍然要做。
